scope: Synthetic laboratory tests only; no real IAF system, confidential data, formal grading or independent assessment.

families.title: Identity, routing and credential denial
families.oracle: No unauthorized session, route bypass or device-bound operation.

families.title: Revocation, races and separation of duties
families.oracle: A revocation committed first produces zero new issuances; no self-approval or concealed metadata leak.

families.title: Object tampering and cryptographic downgrade
families.oracle: Altered stored objects, unknown suites and unavailable providers cannot reach content-key release.

families.title: Custody loss and rollback recovery
families.oracle: Rollback/fork/outage blocks key-bearing operations; recovery retains the independent checkpoint boundary.

families.title: Adapter overload, startup and actual trust boundary
families.oracle: Bound queued requests, preserve exact retry content, reject stale work and false readiness. Record plaintext endpoint exposure as an open deployment blocker.

families.title: Service identity and transport disruption
families.oracle: Wrong service certificates, redirects, oversized/interrupted responses and network revocation must fail closed.

families.title: Endpoint persistence and offline updates
families.oracle: Tampered vault/update, stale state and untrusted authority keys are refused; no silent downgrade.

families.title: Evidence transfer and audit integrity
families.oracle: Invalid signatures, stale evidence, altered packages and self-awarded approval fail verification.

families.title: Monitoring delivery and redaction
families.oracle: Events retain authentication and deduplication; tested telemetry contains no payload/key canaries.

gaps.title: Requirements and permitted operating scope
gaps.current: Public requirements are mapped; classification, users, modes, workload and acceptance values remain unspecified.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Freeze a signed requirements/configuration baseline and permitted Internet data boundary.
gaps.exitEvidence: Approved scope and traceability covering every requirement; no TBD acceptance limit.

gaps.title: Personnel identity and federation
gaps.current: Local password/TOTP, enrollment and device proofs exist; NEXORA is only an offline evidence integration.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Integrate the nominated issuer/PKI, joiner/mover/leaver workflows, recovery and issuer-outage policy.
gaps.exitEvidence: Witnessed issuer, revoked-user, stale-token, phishing/recovery and account-lifecycle trials.

gaps.title: Permitted cryptographic implementation
gaps.current: Software classical provider and lab-only PQC exist; required SAG process remains pending.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Integrate the supplied module/SDK and exact suite/profile; complete the agreed independent review.
gaps.exitEvidence: Decision referencing exact module, firmware, configuration and conditions, with negative provider tests.

gaps.title: Key custody, rotation and recovery
gaps.current: Software keys and lifecycle abstractions exist; hardware custody, fleet rotation and recovery are incomplete.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Implement required HSM/token/attestation operations, device-loss response, rollover and authorized recovery.
gaps.exitEvidence: Extractability/removal/rotation/recovery/zeroisation results on selected hardware and agreed policy.

gaps.title: Plaintext boundary of synthetic document integration
gaps.current: The adapter receives plaintext payloads and owns software endpoint credentials; the source outbox persists plaintext request data. It is a trusted endpoint, not an untrusted relay.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Agree endpoint placement. Move sealing/key ownership into the originating system if the connector must be untrusted; replace the synthetic schema with the supplied contract.
gaps.exitEvidence: Canary and key scans of every declared untrusted process/store are negative; interface and trust-boundary review is accepted.

gaps.title: High availability without split-brain release
gaps.current: The authority is one SQLite writer; container isolation is not multi-host consensus.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Design and implement single-writer fencing/failover and durable custody on independently administered hosts.
gaps.exitEvidence: Witnessed leader loss, partition, restore and competing-writer trials with zero unauthorized/duplicate issuance and agreed RPO/RTO.

gaps.title: Internet perimeter and resource exhaustion
gaps.current: TLS/mTLS and application bounds exist; provider-grade DDoS protection, aggregate connection quotas and production capacity are unproven.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Configure permitted ingress, firewall, service isolation, request/connection budgets and load shedding.
gaps.exitEvidence: Independent slow-client, connection flood, memory/disk exhaustion and lateral movement results on agreed topology.

gaps.title: Backup, retention and disaster recovery
gaps.current: Rollback controls and synthetic restore tests exist; retention/compaction and independent-host recovery remain incomplete.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Implement approved retention and deletion, encrypted backup custody, restore procedures and regular drills.
gaps.exitEvidence: Witnessed restore from damaged/missing media with retained checkpoints, measured RPO/RTO and no stale authorization.

gaps.title: Long-running adapter authentication lifecycle
gaps.current: Session expiration now withdraws readiness. Automatic renewal/recovery is not implemented and must not bypass user/device revocation.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Implement bounded supervised reauthentication with the agreed service identity and recovery policy.
gaps.exitEvidence: Soak spans multiple credential expiries; failed renewal stays unavailable and revoked credentials never regain access.

gaps.title: Scale, latency and communication modes
gaps.current: Text/file workflows and synthetic impairment tests exist; fleet concurrency, large attachments, multi-recipient behavior and required real-time modes remain unqualified.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Agree modes and load envelope; implement missing modes and queue/backpressure/capacity controls; run sustained representative tests.
gaps.exitEvidence: Latency percentiles, throughput, resource ceilings and long-duration recovery satisfy sponsor-agreed limits.

gaps.title: Content safety and endpoint data handling
gaps.current: File validation is not malware scanning. Decrypted content and endpoint compromise remain outside server-side revocation.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Implement required endpoint scanning, safe viewers, storage/session-lock and leakage controls consistent with the approved E2EE boundary.
gaps.exitEvidence: Malicious-file, unsafe-viewer, disk-cache, clipboard/print and lost-device procedures are tested for the approved scope.

gaps.title: Operational monitoring and incident response
gaps.current: Authenticated redacted telemetry exists; no real SOC/SIEM integration or incident-response acceptance.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Integrate agreed event schema/transport, alert escalation, monitoring availability and retention.
gaps.exitEvidence: Redaction and event completeness verified with SOC ingestion, outage replay and a witnessed response exercise.

gaps.title: Managed fleet and device posture
gaps.current: Software key possession does not prove hardware/OS integrity; enrolment is laboratory-managed.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Integrate nominated MDM/attestation, OS/browser support, update policy and device-loss response.
gaps.exitEvidence: Supported fleet matrix, disallowed posture, expired certificates and lost-device recovery tested on actual hardware.

gaps.title: Usability, accessibility and support material
gaps.current: Operator UI and Chromium tests exist; representative user trials and cross-browser/accessibility coverage are incomplete.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Complete role-based user/admin/training/maintenance manuals and task-based accessibility trials.
gaps.exitEvidence: Representative personnel complete enrollment, approvals, exchange, denial and recovery tasks against agreed criteria.

gaps.title: Final release and supplier assurance
gaps.current: Pinned sources, application SBOM and signed offline updates exist; software signing keys are laboratory keys and SBOM scope excludes full OS/firmware.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Freeze final hardware/runtime/modules, complete supplier inventory and protected signing/revocation/rollback ceremonies.
gaps.exitEvidence: Independent offline installation/update/rollback and full inventory verified against exact accepted configuration.

gaps.title: Independent adversarial assessment
gaps.current: Repository tests are applicant-authored evidence; no independent assessment is established.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Agree rules of engagement and test profile; execute independent penetration, protocol and cryptographic assessment; remediate and retest.
gaps.exitEvidence: Signed findings and retests against exact candidate, with no unresolved disqualifying defect under agreed criteria.

gaps.owner: SYNTRIASS proposal owner + IAF programme owner
gaps.title: Filed-scope and lifecycle support reconciliation
gaps.current: Filed role/workflow, licensing, budget and support commitments require owner/sponsor confirmation.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Reconcile implemented features and omissions with filed/contract deliverables; agree lifecycle support and training.
gaps.exitEvidence: Accepted deliverable matrix, support/maintenance arrangements and licensing records.

gaps.title: Historical adapter startup failure
gaps.current: Earlier ADAPTER_EXITED was not diagnosed. Bounded readiness and safe stage/reason diagnostics are now implemented and tested.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Retain diagnostics on recurrence; identify the original failure mechanism or establish an agreed closure rationale with soak evidence.
gaps.exitEvidence: Reproduction and root-cause fix/retest, or assessor-accepted disposition; later green runs alone do not close it.

gaps.title: Operational prototype trials and final qualification
gaps.current: No sponsor-defined operational trial, complete-system qualification or operational authorization is established.
gaps.implementationNeeded: Execute authorized representative and operational-environment trials, close accepted exit criteria, and obtain final qualification decision.
gaps.exitEvidence: Documented complete-system qualification for exact configuration; TRL decision and operational authorization recorded separately.
